events.text: Look at the moss on this ledge. You can see every strand.
That loot is coming with me. Let me just check something first.
Remember this ledge. Remember this ledge.
Loot secured. Now, any paint around here?
Dead end. Same jump, other direction.
Is that real-time ray tracing on the puddles?
My stamina wheel is so pretty. I want to drain it on purpose.
Is that real-time ray tracing on the puddles?
A waystone! I can see the waystone!
No yellow... but the waystone is RIGHT THERE.
I did it! All by myself!

profile.intro: 100% completion on everything, including games she hated. If it sparkles, she wants it before she leaves.
